== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The early Lost mode draws two battle destiny only when otherwise unable to draw the required number. The later Lost mode adds one. The Used mode preserves the opponent’s draw cap at the qualifying battle and spells out Boba Fett. Both issuer titles end with the same question mark.
